title: Publish current Windows driver evidence
requires: Windows CUDA and D3D12 on the same GPU
scope: Rebuild the current clean revision for CUDA and D3D12, execute applicable public-API reference, physical-quality and adverse-lifecycle contracts, and publish revisioned per-driver qualification inputs without hiding failed, missing or unsupported scope.
acceptance: Each submitted driver result pins the clean source revision, driver binary, device, driver and toolchain plus immutable contract hashes.

Applicable trajectory, analytic-quality and adverse-lifecycle contracts are executed on both drivers; failures, missing contracts and unsupported cases remain explicit and cannot certify a capability.
Register the results in the generated per-driver evidence index and verify the index from a Windows checkout without weakening byte-stable contract identity.
